data_sources: deterministic sieve of Eratosthenes [0, 10^8]; no external data
decision_rule: H0_SUPPORTED if G1 (chi2 not sig after BH-FDR across 4 blocks) AND G2 (bootstrap 95% CI of mean(delta_b) contains 1 for all 4 blocks) AND G3 (tail z not sig after BH-FDR across 20 cells) AND G4 (KS agrees with G1 after BH-FDR) AND C1 passes AND C2 passes AND C7 agrees block-by-block. INCONCLUSIVE if any gate ambiguous or any control fails while primary gates pass. H1_SUPPORTED if G1 or G2 or G3 rejects AND deviation survives C6 (>=2 disjoint ranges) AND C7 agrees.
note: Frozen before execution. Primary H0: normalized prime gaps delta = (p_{i+1}-p_i)/ln(p_i) follow Exp(1) (Gallagher/Poisson, 1976) in each of four disjoint ranges to 10^8; gates: chi2 GOF (quantile bins), KS vs Exp(1), binomial tail survival at t in {1,2,3,4,5}; controls: null/random, positive (mean-1 Gamma surrogate), seed ladder, resolution variation, method agreement, residue conditioning; C7 independent implementation required.

bootstrap.what: percentile 95% CI on mean(delta_b) per block

independent_replication.name: C7 independent implementation
requirements: different binning scheme (equal-width instead of exponential-quantile)
block-by-block H0/H1 verdict must match primary
chi2/KS vectors must match within recorded tolerance

null_control.expected: MUST NOT flag any significant deviation after BH-FDR (calibration)
null_control.name: C1 null/random control

output_schema.primary_results: per-block chi2, dof, p, chi2_red, combined chi2, KS stat/p, mean, std, bootstrap CI, tail cells (z/p/fdr_q)

positive_control.expected: MUST flag a significant deviation after BH-FDR (validates gates)
positive_control.name: C2 positive control

preregistered_analyses: chi-square GOF vs Exp(1) (10 quantile bins)
binomial tail survival at t in {1,2,3,4,5}

residue_conditioning.expected: no significant deviation after conditioning; if primary rejects, it must survive in >=2 disjoint ranges
residue_conditioning.name: C6 residue-class conditioning (falsification robustness)

resolution_variation.expected: chi2 GOF verdict identical across J
resolution_variation.name: C4 resolution variation

seed_ladder.what: bootstrap CI verdict must be identical across seeds

sieve.note: deterministic; primes are integers, no randomness

tolerances.tol_c7_vector_match: absolute difference < 1e-9 on chi2; identical verdict

binomial tail survival at t in {1,2,3,4,5}
